foundation.title:
Quiet confidence.
Every detail considered.
foundation.intro: Figtree, a neutral canvas, and one deliberate accent. A visual language that gives the product room to speak.
foundation.palette_note: Orange is a brand moment. Charcoal carries actions, hierarchy, and selection. Status colours are reserved for feedback.
foundation.type_note: Figtree throughout. Weight and proportion create hierarchy; sentence case keeps the experience human.
foundation.body_sample: Clear information. Considered choices. Room for the product.
foundation.heading: Heading
foundation.caption: Caption
foundation.space_note: A 4px foundation with a deliberate scale. Align related information, then use space to separate ideas.
foundation.shape_note: Pill controls. Square product imagery. Fine rules before borders, and borders before shadows.
foundation.motion_note: Short transitions for controls, measured movement for drawers. Product stories can be more expressive. Respect reduced motion.
foundation.layout_note: Two product columns on mobile, three on tablet, four on desktop. Text reflows and controls remain comfortable to reach.
foundation.swatches_note: Product colour swatches are deferred. Use labelled text choices when a colour decision is required.

component.title:
Useful alone.
Consistent together.
component.intro: Interact with each example. Every control uses the same foundations and a visible keyboard focus.
component.actions_note: One primary action per decision. Use secondary and text actions for supporting choices.
component.forms_note: Keep labels visible. Put helpful context before errors, and explain how to recover.
component.feedback_note: Use text and icons alongside colour. Preserve the customer's work when an action fails.
component.disclosure_note: Reveal detail on demand. Use tabs for related content, and accordions for independent answers.
component.overlays_note: Move focus into the surface, contain keyboard focus, and return it to the trigger when closed.
component.state_note: Choose a state to inspect feedback using the same component anatomy.
component.empty_help: Try fewer filters or a different search.
component.error_help: Your choices are safe. Try again.
component.email_hint: We'll use this only for the updates you request.
component.email_success: Your example form is valid. Nothing was submitted.
component.terms: I agree to receive product updates
component.notice_body: Your string and tension are included in the summary.
component.dialog_body: A dialog brings one task into focus. Escape or Close returns you to where you started.
component.drawer_body: Drawers keep the current page close while you browse, filter, or review a selection.
component.tab_details: Give customers a concise introduction supported by verified product details.
component.tab_specs: Use aligned labels and values to make product comparisons easier.
component.tab_care: Keep care instructions specific to the product and supported by official guidance.
component.faq_1_body: The heading is a button-sized target. Enter or Space expands it, and the content follows in the reading order.
component.faq_2: When should a drawer be used?
component.faq_2_body: Use a drawer for a supporting task such as filtering, reviewing a cart, or changing a product option.

commerce.title:
The parts.
And the whole journey.
commerce.intro: Follow the collection through a product, stringing, and the cart. The same components do the work at every step.
commerce.collection_note: Two cards across on mobile. Image, name, one useful detail, and price. Colour swatches are omitted.
commerce.product_note: Keep variant choices, availability, full pricing, and the primary action together.
commerce.stringing_note: A complete selection flow with the existing sequence and one selected service price.
commerce.cart_note: Show the exact product and customisation choices, and keep quantities and totals connected.
commerce.recommendations_note: Consistent cards, mobile swipe, and explicit navigation controls.
commerce.campaign_note: Let imagery and a measured change of scale carry the story. Sale styling is a controlled exception.
commerce.fixture_note: The four-product sample uses captured official product data. See Sources in the guidelines for dates and limitations.

guidelines.title:
Keep the system
considered.
guidelines.intro: Rules that make the next decision easier, with a shared source of truth for the team.
principles_items: Give imagery room. Keep names, specifications, prices, and choices easy to compare.
Use one charcoal primary action in each decision area. Orange supports the brand.
Use space and type before boxes and shadows. Add useful information, not decoration.
Explain unavailable options and errors, retain work, and keep prices complete.
usage_items: Pill shape, clear action labels, visible focus, and a comfortably sized target. Avoid competing primary actions.
Square media, two mobile columns, concise specifications. Open the product page. No colour swatches in v1.
Visible labels, nearby help, specific errors. Never communicate state with colour alone.
String → colour → tension → method → review. Respect the racket limit. Four knots replaces the base service.
150ms for small feedback, 240ms for overlays, 400ms for editorial moments. Reduce motion when requested.
Quiet everyday pricing. Campaign labels must reflect a real offer before use in the store.
guidelines.accessibility_note: Keyboard support, native form semantics, dialog focus containment and restoration, text alternatives, readable contrast, and reduced motion are baseline requirements. Automated checks supplement manual review.
guidelines.adoption_note: This library is an isolated reference implementation. Map its tokens and markup into Liquid and Preact one component at a time; verify the real cart and checkout before releasing theme changes.
guidelines.source_note: Official HNDRD catalogue and public product data, captured {date}. Figtree is distributed under the SIL Open Font License. Existing theme icons are reused. Reference captures: On, Cowboy, and Custo. Aesop could not be captured and was excluded with your approval.
guidelines.limits_note: English / INR sample. In-memory cart only. No live checkout, payments, inventory sync, or theme adoption. Other specialist flows and colour swatches are deferred.
guidelines.tokens_note: The JSON file is the source of truth. CSS variables are generated from it and shared by all examples.
